# Key findings (auto-generated from the data)

- **Scale** - 43,145 delivered orders, ₹2.31 Cr net revenue, 8,805 purchasing customers, AOV ₹536, gross margin 15.0%
- **Growth** - Monthly revenue grew from ₹73,744 (2025-01) to ₹19.0 L (2026-10).
- **Festive** - October 2025 (Diwali) revenue rose 32% month-on-month with AOV at ₹612.
- **Retention** - Customer-weighted retention: 51.5% in month 1, 26.6% in month 3, 11.1% in month 6.
- **Delivery** - Orders delivered within 20 min had a 76% 30-day repeat rate vs 58% when slower - a 18 pp drop (18% of orders were slower than 20 min).
- **Discount** - Gross margin falls from 23.9% at 0% discount to -1.6% at 25%; 30-day repeat rate is 76% vs 67% - deeper discounts did not buy more repeat orders.
- **Channel** - Referral has the best 90-day LTV:CAC (3.57x); Influencer the worst (0.55x).
- **Rfm** - 'Champions' are 19% of customers but 41% of revenue.
- **At Risk** - 1,149 high-value customers are drifting away (₹52.1 L lifetime revenue).
- **Category** - Staples (Atta, Rice, Oil) leads GMV (13% share, 10% margin); Personal Care has the best margin (37%).
- **City** - Delhi NCR is the largest city by revenue; Jaipur is the slowest (20.7 min avg delivery).
- **Churn** - Best model (logistic regression) scores ROC-AUC 0.836 on a later, unseen time window; the 10% of customers flagged riskiest actually churned 98% of the time vs 58% overall (logistic 0.836 vs gradient boosting 0.825 AUC).
